_doc: Exceptions for the hard-coded string lint in tools/test-i18n.js. 'global' texts are allowed in every scanned file, 'files' only in that file. An entry is an exact text (as the lint prints it) or a /regex/flags. Keep it short: a text a player reads belongs in the dictionaries (docs/I18N.md).
_sameAsEnglishDoc: Dictionary keys whose translation is deliberately the same text as the English one (proper names, years, words that are the same in the language). Every other translated text must differ from English (tools/test-i18n.js, completeness). Exact keys or /regex/.
